transcript.en: What is Dad doing?
(A) He is reading the newspaper.
(B) He is washing cups.
(C) He is getting dressed.
What is in this room?
(A) A television
(B) A washing machine
(C) An air conditioner
How does younger brother get to the bookstore?
(A) He takes the train.
(B) He takes the bus.
(C) He takes a taxi.

transcript.py: Tāmen jiā yǒu jǐ ge rén?
transcript.en: How many people are in their family?
(A) Three people
(B) Four people
(C) Five people

transcript.zh: 哥哥今天要做什麼給大家吃？
transcript.py: Gēge jīntiān yào zuò shénme gěi dàjiā chī?
transcript.en: What is older brother making for everyone to eat today?
(A) Bread
(B) Baozi (steamed buns)
(C) Dumplings
How is this skirt?
(A) It's too big.
(B) It's too dirty.
(C) It's too old.

transcript.zh: 王小姐帶了什麼去旅行？
transcript.py: Wángxiǎojiě dài le shénme qù lǚxíng?
transcript.en: What did Miss Wang bring on her trip?
(A) A cell phone
(B) A map
(C) A computer
Where is this lady?
(A) She is in the bedroom.
(B) She is in the living room.
(C) She is in the kitchen.
What did Mom receive?
(A) She received a letter.
(B) She received a book.
(C) She received an email.

transcript.zh: 學生們在教室裡做什麼？
transcript.py: Xuéshēng men zài jiàoshì lǐ zuò shénme?
transcript.en: What are the students doing in the classroom?
(A) They are talking.
(B) They are washing the windows.
(C) They are writing on the blackboard.
What is Wenhua doing?
(A) Hiking (climbing a mountain)
(B) Swimming
(C) Playing ball

transcript.zh: 這三個人，哪一個人最矮？
transcript.py: Zhè sān ge rén, nǎ yí ge rén zuìǎi?
transcript.en: Of these three people, which one is the shortest?
(A) The boy in shorts is the shortest.
(B) The girl in shorts is the shortest.
(C) The girl in long pants is the shortest.

transcript.zh: 李先生和同事在做什麼？
transcript.py: Lǐxiānsheng hé tóngshì zài zuò shénme?
transcript.en: What are Mr. Li and his colleagues doing?
(A) They are drinking.
(B) They are ordering food.
(C) They are having a meeting.

transcript.zh: 弟弟跑步以後，覺得怎麼樣？
transcript.en: How does younger brother feel after running?
(A) He feels very hungry.
(B) He feels very tired.
(C) He feels very thirsty.
What is the girl doing?
(A) She is walking up the stairs.
(B) She is running into the elevator.
(C) She is walking out of the elevator.
What does younger sister do on weekends?
(A) Walking
(B) Cycling
(C) Taking a stroll
What is next to the house?
(A) A restaurant
(B) A bank
(C) A park
Where does Miss Li work?
(A) She works at the post office.
(B) She works at a hospital.
(C) She works in a factory.
What class are they in?
(A) Math class
(B) Music class
(C) Science class
What is in the picture?
(A) Fish
(B) A dog
(C) Birds
What is older sister's hobby?
(A) Reading magazines
(B) Learning a musical instrument
(C) Practicing calligraphy

transcript.zh: 大明計劃暑假的時候做什麼？
transcript.py: Dàmíng jìhuà shǔjià de shíhòu zuò shénme?
transcript.en: What is Daming planning to do during summer vacation?
(A) Clean the house
(B) Go to a dance party
(C) Visit a museum
Which item is more expensive?
(A) The short skirt
(B) The shorts
(C) The long pants
What happened to Xiaoming?
(A) He forgot to bring something.

What are these people doing?
(A) Lining up to register (at a clinic)

(C) Presenting a plan

transcript.py: Nán: Nǐ de dìdi bǐ nǐ gāo ma?
transcript.en: Man: Is your younger brother taller than you?

transcript.zh: 女：是啊，我的弟弟比我高，也比我胖。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Shì a, wǒ de dìdi bǐ wǒ gāo, yě bǐ wǒ pàng.
transcript.en: Woman: Yes, my younger brother is taller than me, and heavier too.

transcript.zh: 男：請問賣照相機的店在哪兒？
transcript.py: Nán: Qǐngwèn mài zhàoxiàngjī de diàn zài nǎér?
transcript.en: Man: Excuse me, where is the camera shop?
Woman: Next to the intersection.

transcript.zh: 男：週末一起出去玩好不好？
transcript.en: Man: Let's go out together this weekend, OK?

transcript.zh: 女：我很想，可是我要工作。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wǒ hěn xiǎng, kěshì wǒ yào gōngzuò.
transcript.en: Woman: I'd love to, but I have to work.

transcript.py: Nán: Diànyǐngyuàn lí zhèlǐ yuǎn ma?
transcript.en: Man: Is the movie theater far from here?

transcript.py: Nǚ: Bùyuǎn, jiù zài cāntīng lóuxià.
transcript.en: Woman: Not far—it's right downstairs from the restaurant.

transcript.py: Nán: Zuótiān de biǎoyǎn hǎokàn ma?
transcript.en: Man: Was yesterday's performance good?

transcript.zh: 女：非常有趣，去的人很多。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Fēicháng yǒuqù, qù de rén hěnduō.
transcript.en: Woman: Very entertaining; lots of people went.

transcript.zh: 男：喂，您好，請問，張小姐在家嗎？
transcript.py: Nán: Wèi, nínhǎo, qǐngwèn, zhāng Xiǎojiě zàijiā ma?
transcript.en: Man: Hello, is Miss Zhang at home?

transcript.zh: 女：喔，她不在，她出去買東西了。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Ō, tā bù zài, tā chūqù mǎi Dōngxi le.
transcript.en: Woman: Oh, she's not here; she went out shopping.

transcript.zh: 男：您好，請問洗手間在哪兒？
transcript.py: Nán: Nínhǎo, qǐngwèn xǐshǒujiān zài nǎér?
transcript.en: Man: Hello, where is the restroom, please?
Woman: The restroom is on the second floor.

transcript.zh: 男：這件毛衣和牛仔褲真好看，你覺得呢？
transcript.py: Nán: Zhèjiàn máoyī hé niúzǎikù zhēn hǎokàn, nǐ juéde ne?
transcript.en: Man: This sweater and these jeans look great. What do you think?

transcript.zh: 女：我也覺得很好看，我們都買吧！
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wǒ yě juéde hěn hǎokàn, wǒmen dōu mǎi ba!
transcript.en: Woman: I think they look great too. Let's buy both!

transcript.zh: 男：我的錢在旅館不見了！怎麼辦？
transcript.py: Nán: Wǒ de qián zài lǚguǎn bújiàn le! Zěnmebàn?
transcript.en: Man: My money disappeared at the hotel! What should I do?

transcript.zh: 女：前面有警察局，我們去找警察幫忙。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Qiánmiàn yǒu jǐngchájú, wǒmen qù zhǎo jǐngchá bāngmáng.
transcript.en: Woman: There's a police station ahead; let's ask the police for help.

transcript.zh: 男：李小姐為什麼下個月要請假？
transcript.py: Nán: Lǐxiǎojiě wèishénme xiàgèyuè yào qǐngjià?
transcript.en: Man: Why is Miss Li taking leave next month?

transcript.zh: 女：你不知道啊？她下個月要結婚了！
transcript.py: Nǚ: Nǐ bù zhīdào a? Tā xiàgèyuè yào jiéhūn le!
transcript.en: Woman: You didn't know? She's getting married next month!

transcript.zh: 男：你買新鞋啊？這雙鞋子要五百塊吧？
transcript.py: Nán: Nǐ mǎi xīnxié a? Zhè shuāng xiézi yào wǔbǎikuài ba?
transcript.en: Man: Did you buy new shoes? These shoes must cost 500 dollars, right?

transcript.zh: 女：五百？我可以買兩雙了。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wǔbǎi? Wǒ kěyǐ mǎi liǎngshuāng le.
transcript.en: Woman: Five hundred? I could buy two pairs with that.

transcript.zh: 男：美美的生日快到了，妳要送什麼禮物給她呢？
transcript.py: Nán: Měiměi de shēngrì kuài dào le, nǐ yào sòng shénme lǐwù gěi tā ne?
transcript.en: Man: Meimei's birthday is coming. What present are you giving her?

transcript.zh: 女：我打算做個蛋糕給她。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wǒ dǎsuàn zuò gè dàngāo gěi tā.
transcript.en: Woman: I'm planning to make her a cake.

transcript.zh: 男：妳畫畫畫得真好，可不可以幫我在牆上畫一些花？
transcript.py: Nán: Nǐ huàhuà huà dé zhēnhǎo, kěbùkěyǐ bāng wǒ zài qiángshàng huà yìxiē huā?
transcript.en: Man: You draw so well. Could you paint some flowers on my wall?

transcript.zh: 女：沒問題，我畫一些你家院子裡的花吧！
transcript.py: Nǚ: Méi wèntí, wǒ huà yìxiē nǐjiā yuànzi lǐ de huā ba!
transcript.en: Woman: No problem. I'll paint some of the flowers in your yard!

transcript.zh: 男：小寶最近吵著要買玩具車，你覺得呢？
transcript.py: Nán: Xiǎobǎo zuìjìn chǎozhù yào mǎi wánjùchē, nǐ juéde ne?
transcript.en: Man: Xiaobao has been pestering us lately to buy him a toy car. What do you think?

transcript.zh: 女：他最近很乖，就買給他吧！
transcript.py: Nǚ: Tā zuìjìn hěnguāi, jiù mǎi gěi tā ba!
transcript.en: Woman: He's been very good lately—let's buy it for him!

transcript.zh: 男：新家的環境，你滿意嗎？
transcript.py: Nán: Xīnjiā de huánjìng, nǐ mǎnyì ma?
transcript.en: Man: Are you satisfied with the surroundings of your new home?

transcript.zh: 女：我非常喜歡！打開窗戶就能看見花園。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wǒ fēicháng xǐhuān! Dǎkāi chuānghù jiù néng kànjiàn huāyuán.
transcript.en: Woman: I love it! When I open the window I can see the garden.
Man: Excuse me, is Manager Wang in?

transcript.zh: 女：他正在辦公室和顧客談事情。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Tā zhèngzài bàngōngshì hé Gùkè tán shìqing.
transcript.en: Woman: He's talking with a client in his office.

transcript.zh: 男：這樣子啊。那麼，請問他的辦公室在哪裡？
transcript.py: Nán: Zhè yàngzi a. Nàme, qǐngwèn tā de bàngōngshì zài nǎlǐ?
transcript.en: Man: I see. Then where is his office, please?

transcript.zh: 女：電梯旁邊第二間，門上掛著一張畫的就是了。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Diàntī pángbiān dìèrjiān, ménshàng guàzhù yìzhāng huà de jiùshì le.
transcript.en: Woman: The second room next to the elevator—the one with a painting hanging on the door.

transcript.zh: 男：請問王經理的辦公室在哪裡？
transcript.py: Nán: Qǐngwèn Wángjīnglǐ de bàngōngshì zài nǎlǐ?
transcript.en: Man: Where is Manager Wang's office?

transcript.zh: 男：冰箱裡有冰淇淋，妳想吃嗎？
transcript.py: Nán: Bīngxiāng lǐ yǒu Bīngqílín, nǐ xiǎng chī ma?
transcript.en: Man: There's ice cream in the fridge. Do you want some?

transcript.zh: 女：我想吃一些鹹的點心。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wǒ xiǎng chī yìxiē xián de diǎnxīn.
transcript.en: Woman: I'd like some salty snacks.

transcript.zh: 男：有鹹的三明治和餅乾，妳想吃哪一種？
transcript.py: Nán: Yǒu xián de Sānmíngzhì hé bǐnggān, nǐ xiǎng chī nǎ yìzhǒng?
transcript.en: Man: There are savory sandwiches and crackers. Which would you like?

transcript.py: Nǚ: Wǒ quánbù dōu xiǎng chī.
transcript.en: Woman: I want to eat all of them.

transcript.py: Nán: Qǐngwèn nǚshēng xiǎng chī shénme?
transcript.en: Man: What does the woman want to eat?

transcript.zh: 男：小美剛剛留言，請你收傳真！
transcript.py: Nán: Xiǎoměi gānggāng liúyán, qǐng nǐ shōu chuánzhēn!
transcript.en: Man: Xiaomei just left a message asking you to receive a fax!

transcript.zh: 女：好的，她還說了什麼嗎？
transcript.py: Nǚ: Hǎo de, tā hái shuō le shénme ma?
transcript.en: Woman: OK. Did she say anything else?

transcript.zh: 男：沒有，但是請妳收傳真的時候，幫我跟王先生借字典，好嗎？
transcript.py: Nán: Méiyǒu, dànshì qǐng nǐ shōu chuánzhēn de shíhòu, bāng wǒ gēn Wángxiānsheng jiè zìdiǎn, hǎo ma?
transcript.en: Man: No. But when you receive the fax, could you borrow a dictionary from Mr. Wang for me?
Woman: Sure!

transcript.zh: 男：請問男生請女生幫他做什麼事？
transcript.py: Nán: Qǐngwèn nánshēng qǐng nǚshēng bāng tā zuò shénme shì?
transcript.en: Man: What does the man ask the woman to do for him?

transcript.zh: 男：對不起，房間很髒，我正在打掃。
transcript.py: Nán: Duìbùqǐ, fángjiān hěnzāng, wǒ zhèngzài dǎsǎo.
transcript.en: Man: Sorry, the room is very dirty; I'm cleaning it.

transcript.zh: 女：沒關係，這些盒子要放在哪兒?
transcript.py: Nǚ: Méiguānxì, zhèxiē hézi yào fàngzài nǎér?
transcript.en: Woman: That's OK. Where should these boxes go?

transcript.zh: 男：麻煩妳把它們搬到浴室門口。
transcript.py: Nán: Máfán nǐ bǎ tāmen bān dào yùshì ménkǒu.
transcript.en: Man: Could you please move them to the bathroom door?

transcript.zh: 女：浴室門口都是東西，我放在旁邊的樓梯上。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Yùshì ménkǒu dōu shì Dōngxi, wǒ fàngzài pángbiān de lóutī shàng.
transcript.en: Woman: The bathroom doorway is full of stuff; I'll put them on the stairs next to it.

transcript.zh: 男：請問盒子會被搬到哪兒?
transcript.py: Nán: Qǐngwèn hézi huì bèi bāndào nǎér?
transcript.en: Man: Where will the boxes be moved to?

transcript.py: Nán: Nǐ zěnme zhèmewǎn cái lái?
transcript.en: Man: Why are you so late?

transcript.zh: 女：我剛剛和經理在討論工作。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wǒ gānggāng hé jīnglǐ zài tǎolùn gōngzuò.
transcript.en: Woman: I was just discussing work with the manager.
Man: Discussing what?
Woman: The customer appreciation party.

transcript.zh: 男：請問這位小姐為什麼晚到？
transcript.py: Nán: Qǐngwèn zhèwèi Xiǎojiě wèishénme wǎn dào?
transcript.en: Man: Why did this young lady arrive late?

transcript.zh: 男：最近我的鼻子不太舒服，晚上都睡不好。可以給我一點藥嗎？
transcript.py: Nán: Zuìjìn wǒ de bízi bù tài shūfú, wǎnshàng dōu shuì bùhǎo. Kěyǐ gěi wǒ yìdiǎn yào ma?
transcript.en: Man: Lately my nose has been uncomfortable and I can't sleep well at night. Could you give me some medicine?

transcript.zh: 女：我看看。嗯，還不需要吃藥。多運動會讓你覺得好一點。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wǒ kànkàn. ń, hái bù xūyào chīyào. Duō yùndònghuì ràng nǐ juéde hǎo yìdiǎn.
transcript.en: Woman: Let me take a look. Hmm, you don't need medicine yet. Exercising more will make you feel a bit better.
Man: Do I have a cold?

transcript.zh: 女：不是，春天來的時候，很多人都會有這個問題。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Búshì, chūntiān lái de shíhòu, hěnduō rén dōu huì yǒu zhè ge wèntí.
transcript.en: Woman: No, when spring comes, many people have this problem.

transcript.zh: 男：這位先生的鼻子不舒服和什麼有關係？
transcript.py: Nán: Zhèwèi xiānsheng de bízi bù shūfú hé shénme yǒu guānxì?
transcript.en: Man: What is this gentleman's nose discomfort related to?

A.zh: 她沒辦法讓鄰居安靜一些
A.py: Tā méi bànfǎ ràng línjū Ānjìng yìxiē
A.en: She can't get her neighbors to be a bit quieter.

B.zh: 她想搬到交通方便的地方
B.py: Tā xiǎng bāndào jiāotōng fāngbiàn de dìfāng
B.en: She wants to move somewhere with convenient transportation.

C.zh: 她打算請警察跟鄰居談談
C.py: Tā dǎsuàn qǐng jǐngchá gēn línjū tántán
C.en: She plans to ask the police to talk to the neighbors.

D.zh: 她想找喜歡玩樂器的鄰居
D.py: Tā xiǎng zhǎo xǐhuān wán yuèqì de línjū
D.en: She wants to find neighbors who like playing instruments.

transcript.zh: 男：這裡交通很方便，為什麼想搬家？
transcript.py: Nán: Zhèlǐ jiāotōng hěn fāngbiàn, wèishénme xiǎng bānjiā?
transcript.en: Man: Transportation here is very convenient. Why do you want to move?

transcript.zh: 女：鄰居夜裡經常玩樂器，吵得不得了。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Línjū yèlǐ jīngcháng wán yuèqì, chǎodé bùdéle.
transcript.en: Woman: The neighbors often play instruments at night; it's incredibly noisy.

transcript.zh: 男：不能跟他們談一談嗎？
transcript.py: Nán: Bùnéng gēn tāmen tányìtán ma?
transcript.en: Man: Can't you talk to them?

transcript.zh: 女：談過了，也請警察幫忙了，可是一點用也沒有。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Tán guò le, yě qǐng jǐngchá bāngmáng le, kěshì yìdiǎn yòng yě méiyǒu.
transcript.en: Woman: I've talked to them, and I've also asked the police for help, but it was no use at all.

transcript.zh: 男：這位小姐的意思是什麼？
transcript.py: Nán: Zhèwèi Xiǎojiě de yìsi shì shénme?
transcript.en: Man: What does this young lady mean?

A.py: Tā yě bùxiǎng zuò xuéqī bàogào
A.en: She doesn't want to do the term paper either.

B.zh: 她可以和大明一起討論
B.py: Tā kěyǐ hé Dàmíng yìqǐ tǎolùn
B.en: She can discuss it together with Daming.

C.zh: 大明不需要這麼快做決定
C.py: Dàmíng bù xūyào zhème kuài zuò juédìng
C.en: Daming doesn't need to decide so quickly.

D.zh: 大明應該告訴她發生什麼事
D.py: Dàmíng yīnggāi gàosù tā fāshēng shénme shì
D.en: Daming should tell her what happened.

transcript.zh: 男：我決定不上這個課了。
transcript.py: Nán: Wǒ juédìng búshàng zhè ge kè le.
transcript.en: Man: I've decided not to take this class.

transcript.zh: 女：大明，發生什麼事了嗎？
transcript.py: Nǚ: Dàmíng, fāshēng shénme shì le ma?
transcript.en: Woman: Daming, did something happen?

transcript.zh: 男：我不知道學期報告要怎麼做。
transcript.py: Nán: Wǒ bù zhīdào xuéqī bàogào yào zěnme zuò.
transcript.en: Man: I don't know how to do the term paper.

transcript.zh: 女：這個課的報告真的不容易，但我想你可以先找老師討論。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Zhè ge kè de bàogào zhēnde bù róngyì, dàn wǒ xiǎng nǐ kěyǐ xiān zhǎo lǎoshī tǎolùn.
transcript.en: Woman: The paper for this class really isn't easy, but I think you could discuss it with the teacher first.

transcript.zh: 男：這位小姐的意思是什麼？
transcript.py: Nán: Zhèwèi Xiǎojiě de yìsi shì shénme?
transcript.en: Man: What does this young lady mean?

B.en: She wants to buy new pants.

C.en: The old pants can be thrown away.

transcript.zh: 男：你的牛仔褲髒了！要放進洗衣機洗嗎？
transcript.py: Nán: Nǐ de niúzǎikù zàng le! Yào fàngjìn xǐyījī xǐ ma?
transcript.en: Man: Your jeans are dirty! Should I put them in the washing machine?

transcript.zh: 女：那件已經很舊了，我需要一件新褲子。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Nà jiàn yǐjīng hěn jiù le, wǒ xūyào yíjiàn xīn kùzi.
transcript.en: Woman: Those are already very old; I need a new pair of pants.

transcript.zh: 男：要幫妳把舊褲子丟了嗎？
transcript.py: Nán: Yào bāng nǐ bǎ jiù kùzi diū le ma?
transcript.en: Man: Should I throw away the old pants for you?

transcript.zh: 女：先洗一洗吧！我後天才能去買新的。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Xiānxǐ yī xǐ ba! Wǒ hòutiān cáinéng qù mǎi xīn de.
transcript.en: Woman: Wash them first! I can't go buy new ones until the day after tomorrow.

transcript.zh: 男：這位小姐的意思是什麼？
transcript.py: Nán: Zhèwèi Xiǎojiě de yìsi shì shénme?
transcript.en: Man: What does this young lady mean?

A.zh: 她想請這位先生喝杯飲料
A.py: Tā xiǎng qǐng zhèwèi xiānsheng hēbēi yǐnliào
A.en: She wants to treat this gentleman to a drink.

B.zh: 她知道這位先生常常遲到
B.py: Tā zhīdào zhèwèi xiānsheng chángcháng chídào
B.en: She knows this gentleman is often late.

C.zh: 她相信這位先生工作很忙
C.py: Tā xiāngxìn zhèwèi xiānsheng gōngzuò hěn máng
C.en: She believes this gentleman is very busy with work.

D.zh: 她覺得這位先生應該請客
D.py: Tā juéde zhèwèi xiānsheng yīnggāi qǐngkè
D.en: She thinks this gentleman should treat (pay).

transcript.en: Man: Sorry, I'm late.

transcript.zh: 女：是不是工作太忙，所以比較晚下班？
transcript.py: Nǚ: Shìbúshì gōngzuò tài máng, suǒyǐ bǐjiào wǎn xiàbān?
transcript.en: Woman: Was work too busy, so you got off late?

transcript.zh: 男：不是，是我記錯時間了，真抱歉！
transcript.py: Nán: Búshì, shì wǒ jìcuò shíjiān le, zhēn bàoqiàn!
transcript.en: Man: No, I got the time wrong. I'm really sorry!

transcript.zh: 女：不是因為工作才遲到啊！那你請我喝飲料吧！
transcript.py: Nǚ: Búshì yīnwèi gōngzuò cái chídào a! Nà nǐ qǐng wǒ hē yǐnliào ba!
transcript.en: Woman: So you weren't late because of work! Then you treat me to a drink!

transcript.zh: 男：這位小姐的意思是什麼？
transcript.py: Nán: Zhèwèi Xiǎojiě de yìsi shì shénme?
transcript.en: Man: What does this young lady mean?
